digest.component_or_area: codebase-wide module structure and CI metrics
propositions: 46 files in src/rebar exceed 700 LOC with 7 files at or near the hard cap of 800, creating ongoing maintenance burden and blocking contributors
pass1.py (800 LOC) must be split by extracting the container pairing stage into a new module while relocating _submit_ctx to generation.py to avoid cyclic dependency
push.py (800 LOC) must be split by extracting the recovery cluster (8 functions) into push_recovery.py using late-binding core parameter pattern to preserve monkeypatch sites
A non-blocking near-cap CI warning must be surfaced in the module-size gate to alert developers before the hard cap is hit, using the already-computed module_size_distribution.near_cap_count field
Test-count parity must be maintained across all refactoring changes and the re-export mechanism must preserve all module-level attribute access to prevent breakage in downstream consumers
